marta: Quick sanity check request — planning a small run to tag "enablement_pending" for orphan accounts: created >=7d, zero enablement_events, no owner_claimed. @sunil @lex please review filter and risks.

lex: Paste the exact query you'll use and what we write back. We must exclude recent converts and accounts with pilot=true.

marta: Dry-run SQL:
```sql
SELECT a.account_id, a.created_at, COALESCE(ev.cnt,0) AS enablement_events, o.claimed_at, a.metadata->>'pilot' AS pilot
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM enablement_events WHERE created_at > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY account_id) ev USING (account_id)
LEFT JOIN owners o USING (account_id)
WHERE a.created_at <= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND COALESCE(ev.cnt,0) = 0
  AND (o.claimed_at IS NULL OR o.claimed_at <= now() - interval '30 days')
  AND a.metadata->>'pilot' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
LIMIT 150;
```

sunil: Good. Two operational asks: (1) snapshot healthscore to cs_healthscore_snapshot_v3 before tagging, include owner_claimed boolean; (2) pilot=150, run metrics check and abort if >1% show health_score delta >0.4. Keep rollback steps in runbook.

olivia: Also exclude accounts flagged 'no-contact' and add owner webhook so owners see a nudge when we tag.

marta: Updated job config (dry-run): job_name=enablement_orphan_pilot_20260324; dry_run=true; pilot_limit=150; snapshot_table=cs_healthscore_snapshot_v3; owner_notification=webhook://cs/notify_owner; exclude_flags=["no-contact"]. Kicking off dry-run now. ops-bot: please schedule.
